mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification ( member_id, type, board_seq, comment_seq, message ) VALUES ( #{member_id}, #{type}, #{board_seq, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{comment_seq, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{message} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT seq, member_id, type, board_seq, comment_seq, message, is_read, created_at FROM notification WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY is_read ASC, created_at DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = 'Y' WHERE seq = #{seq} AND is_read = 'N'
UPDATE notification SET is_read = 'Y' WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_read = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_read = 'N'
